Sphingolipid (10 FN; AUR1 set R1825-R1834 inherited (0,0)). What-if V2: open R1825-R1834, 10 duplicate-IPC links, DAG gm->em link, biomass_C += 4.17e-4 IPC-C m1271[go]; WT 0.311460
GPI anchor (6 FN; chain feasible, m603 drained only by R_DM_GPI). What-if b1: biomass_C += 1.70e-4 m603[er], exit open; WT 0.311523
Cardiolipin (2 FN; route unused, no cardiolipin term). What-if a: biomass_C += 7.16e-4 m1651[mm]; WT 0.311060

N-glycan (3 FN; LLO chain split, mannan made by R289). What-if C2 = A2 + B (R289 1:1, Golgi mannan route, Golgi Pi exit, R1137 closed, LLO link + OST, biomass_C += 0.01 N-glycan): WT 0.276393; B alone: WT 0.280770
Mitochondrial translation (8 FN; charged mt tRNAs have no consumer). What-if: translation pseudo-reaction (14 tRNAs), biomass_C += 0.0186 mtprot, R1251 and R1218 reversible; WT 0.310670

Nothing in the model was changed. Model e1e7c868, Task A medium (cond_taskA_po1f.json, R612 closed), Gurobi 1e-9. Reaction colour = scenario value: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 % of the optimum); pFBA = flux at the optimum. Each family's what-if is an in-memory variant from the scouts' scripts, applied ALONE (combined effects were not run).

Node colour: dark red, large = species the what-if adds to biomass_C; purple = species that exist only in a what-if; orange = every mapped reaction of the species is blocked or closed as built (mapped reactions only); grey = otherwise. Hubs repeat; layout is automatic.
WHAT-IF (NOT implemented): pFBA flux at the optimum under each family's recommended variant, each applied ALONE; the demanded route now carries flux in every section
